text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Silence Suzuka, that was a splendid run!
(Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa..., haa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (The air... feels so wonderful...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh. I was so close to passing 
them...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I just can't really 
concentrate.
choice_data_list:
...If you don't mind talking to me, I'm 
all ears.

...If you're fine with me, I'm happy to 
listen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... No, I'm sorry. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. However, I'll 
try to manage on my own somehow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Also... about the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Even if I entered a race right now... I 
feel like I wouldn't be able to run 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It's hard to put into words, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So, um... could you give me a little time 
to think about the Satsuki Sho...?
choice_data_list: ...If you say so, let's do that.
...If you say so, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry...

...That said, having no goal at all isn't 
a good state to be in either.

To keep the possibility of running in the 
autumn Classic race, the 'Kikuka Sho', 
open, why don't we set our sights on 
September's 'Kobe Shimbun Hai' for now?
choice_data_list: How about the Kobe Shimbun Hai?
How about the Kobe Shimbun Hai?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know if I can pull it off.
choice_data_list:
Well, it's better than getting nothing 
from the race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Understood.

The days went by as I constantly wondered 
what I could do for her.
